summary: Iteration 6 — frontend validation of the definitive DIVIPOLA white-screen fix. ALL 7 requested scenarios pass. The `useEffect(load, [])` → `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` refactor in Admin.jsx (UsersTab, CatalogTab, DocenteMateriaTab, DivipolaTab) and Upload.jsx eliminated the 'destroy is not a function' crash that was unmounting the entire React root. The MutationObserver in suppress-leaflet-errors.js plus the wrapper change together produce a stable Admin page across all tabs, with zero webpack-dev-server overlay and zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix architecture is now correct: load functions are explicitly invoked inside the useEffect arrow so React only receives an effect callback that returns `undefined` (a no-op cleanup) instead of a Promise. This eliminates the React-18 passive-cleanup TypeError class entirely — well done.

suppress-leaflet-errors.js MutationObserver is observing only `document.body, {childList:true, subtree:false}`. If webpack ever injects the overlay deeper than a direct child of <body>, the observer will miss it. Consider `{subtree:true}` for resilience (minor; not currently triggered because the root cause is fixed).
Admin.jsx CatalogTab `useEffect(..., [name])` (l.149-153) re-fires when `name` changes — but `name` is a static prop per tab, so effectively single-fire. Acceptable.
Upload.jsx loadAll is also synchronous-wrapper — good. No additional async-arrow leaks detected in the codebase.

rca of the issue: Root cause confirmed: prior `useEffect(load, [])` pattern in Admin.jsx UsersTab/CatalogTab/DivipolaTab and Upload.jsx passed the `load` function reference directly as the effect callback. Whenever `load` returned a Promise (because it contained `api.get(...).then(...)` without explicit `return undefined`, or because it was declared `async`), React 18's commit phase tried to invoke the Promise as a cleanup function on unmount and threw 'destroy is not a function'. That error originates in passive-effect commit and is NOT catchable by ErrorBoundary in React 18, so the entire root unmounted (body collapsed to 18-char 'Made with Emergent' shell) and the webpack-dev-server overlay rendered. Mitigation applied by main agent: (a) wrap calls inside an arrow — `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` — which makes the effect return `undefined`; (b) MutationObserver in suppress-leaflet-errors.js removes #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay if it ever reappears (defense in depth). Both pieces verified working.
